Body.Content:
Azure is providing new built-in, industry-leading governance capabilities to help customers deliver projects more quickly and provide controls for meeting internal and external compliance goals. The services are Azure Blueprints, Azure Policy for DevOps, Azure Resource Graph and Azure Cost Management. They’re included in the Azure platform for no additional cost. Some services are generally available; others are in public preview.

Learn more
